definitions.explanation: The seventh sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly September 23 to October 23. Also the constellation Libra. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天秤座|てんびんざ}だ。
{天秤座|てんびんざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バランス{感覚|かんかく}→バランス感覚：25985_baransukankaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぐれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Libra people are said to have an excellent sense of balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天秤座|てんびんざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人間|にんげん}{関係|かんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うれしいこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧そうだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: It said this week's Libra is likely to have something pleasant happen in relationships.

notes:
The zodiac sign Libra, for people born from late September to late October.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Libra
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Libra
- {天秤座|てんびんざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Libra horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
